The **1957 Soviet Cup** (Кубок СССР по футболу) was the USSR’s national **knockout** football cup competition for that season.

## Winner and final
- **Champions:** **Lokomotiv Moscow**
- **Runners-up:** **Spartak Moscow**
- **Final score:** **Lokomotiv Moscow 1–0 Spartak Moscow**
- **Winning goal:** commonly recorded as scored by **Valentin Bubukin** (Lokomotiv)

## What the competition was
- A **single-elimination** (knockout) cup involving clubs from different tiers of Soviet football (top-league sides entered alongside teams from lower divisions/regions depending on the stage and the year’s regulations).
- Typical Soviet Cup rules of the era generally meant **one-off ties**, with **extra time** and, when required by the regulations in force that season, **replays** to decide drawn matches (the exact tie-breaking procedure could vary by round/year).

## Notability / significance
- **Lokomotiv Moscow’s victory** in 1957 is notable because it is regarded as one of the club’s major early cup successes and a landmark trophy in their Soviet-era history.
- The final being **Lokomotiv vs Spartak** put a traditionally “railway” sports society club against one of the USSR’s biggest and most popular clubs.
